summary: The portal has an Artifacts section listing the files Nora sent in your rooms, and a link Nora sends for a file now opens there behind sign-in instead of on a public page.
details: Artifacts lists every file Nora attached in a chat and every file she linked, for the rooms you are in, newest first, with search and a download for each.
Only people in the room a file was sent in can open it, checked every time; leaving a room takes its files away.
Files Nora keeps for herself are never listed.
Pictures, audio and video open in the browser; every other file, PDFs and SVGs included, downloads instead.
limitations: A link needs a portal account, so someone outside the circle cannot open it; Nora should attach the file in the chat for them instead.
Links Nora made before this change, on the old public file service, are not moved here.
